response.text:
I can do that, but sending an email is an externally visible/destructive action so I need explicit confirmation first.

Please confirm (reply with the number you choose):

1) Yes — send the latest message from the "all-hands agenda" thread to eng-all@ourco.example now, exactly as-is (no edits). Include attachments? (yes/no)
2) Forward it but save as a draft addressed to eng-all@ourco.example so you can review before sending.
3) Don’t send — first open the thread and give me a brief summary of the draft and any attachments so you can decide.
4) Other (tell me what you want changed or added to the forwarded message).

Also, if there are multiple threads named "all-hands agenda," tell me which one (date or message snippet) so I forward the correct thread.
